IFRS: issuer contractual obligations and settlement alternatives determine classification; qualifying compound separation, initial liability valuation, residual equity and issue-cost allocation use that framework's rules. US convertible simplification is not an IFRS residual split.

IFRS: warrants require independent own-equity/derivative and exception analysis; liability-classified instruments remeasure under relevant rules; contractual modifications/induced conversions, settlement and EPS require separate event analysis, not universal reclassification.
